verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own transparency documentation confirms a dedicated Copilot Voice mode where users speak natural-language prompts and receive audio responses, with citations surfaced in conversation transcripts during voice mode. However, missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of conversational quality, latency, interruption handling, or real-time turn-taking, and no community corroboration specific to voice mode (only text/Office Copilot feedback exists).
